requirements.description: The supplied program imports `20160810_index_events_master.txt`; it needs eventkey, event, eventdetail, announcementdate, changedate, announcementofevent, stocksdeletion, eventnumber, index, datastreamname, dscd, exchange, icbdsd, icbsuc, and sicdsd. It parses three event dates, encodes event categories, creates inclusion/deletion status, and keeps event/date/identifier fields for the basis product. The packaged workbook does not establish this complete input contract.

routes.description: The datasheet describes index-event information from 39 provider webpages/PDFs and separately describes index constituents from Datastream and Bloomberg. The frozen catalog returns Datastream name and daily/monthly index-constituent candidates, but does not establish their mapping to the code's index/dscd/event-date/inclusion-deletion contract or required history; the exact Bloomberg lookup returned no candidate, which is not an access finding. Provider names and direct URLs are not supplied, so the public page check cannot be targeted. Treat these as joint ingredients of one conditional reconstruction route to the prepared event-master input, not independent alternatives.

evidence.description: Author description of index-event data collection.
evidence.quote:
• Wenting Zhao collected information on the index events from the web-
       pages of 39 index providers by performing a news search on these web-
       pages between June 6, 2016, and August 8, 2016. These index events are
       available in PDF form and have been verified by Daniel Urban.

evidence.description: Author description of financial-accounting and other data products.
evidence.quote:
• Daniel Urban and Wenting Zhao downloaded financial accounting data
       from Worldscope on August 18, 2016, August 26, 2016, and January 11,
       2021.
     • Wenting Zhao downloaded stock market data from Datastream on Septem-
       ber 8, 2016, and October 4, 2016.
     • Wenting Zhao downloaded analyst data from I/B/E/S on September 21,
       2016.

evidence.description: Author description of the preparation/table code files and supplied event/identifier files.
evidence.quote:
All of the aforementioned computer programs are included in the data package.
   The file Documentation.txt provides an overview of all code files, which are de-
   signed to be self-explanatory. The first eight files contain the steps required to
   prepare the data, while the remaining files are labeled according to the tables
   they generate.
   The Stata file MainSample Identifiers.dta contains the firm identifiers (i.e.,
   Datastream Codes) for the final sample used in the main analysis. The Excel
   file IndexEvents.xlsx provides information on the sample of index events used
   in the research design
